decision.case_state: Ticket reopened at mp_time (provider books visit). Lantern Services asked to do a no-charge return visit and confirm a date. Tenant and landlord told. Invoice £75.11 held. Follow-up set for 2024-03-07.

next_actions.action: Ask Lantern Services for a no-charge guarantee return visit, to confirm the date, and to send photos
Apologise, confirm reopening, say nothing is booked yet, and say we will update by 7 March
Tell the landlord the fault recurred and the return visit is no-charge; any charge comes back to them first
Review provider confirmation of the visit on 7 March

boundaries: Reopening does not book a visit or confirm the cause of the fault.
Holding the payment does not decide whether the invoice is payable.
No landlord approval was needed because the return visit is under guarantee.
remaining_work: Lantern Services to confirm the visit date with the tenant and the agency.
Record the work result, then the invoice and final checks, and close with the landlord informed.

The invoice is dated July 2026 in the summary, which looks wrong.
decision.summary: The tenant reports the washing machine fault returned after the closed repair. I reopened the job, asked Lantern Services to return under guarantee at no charge, held their invoice, and updated the tenant and landlord.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: It was closed on 28 Feb, with no photos and no landlord confirmation. The tenant says the fix failed. It is now reopened at the provider-booking stage. A return visit date is outstanding, and the invoice is on hold.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Lantern Services, by email, for a no-charge guarantee return visit and a confirmed date. The tenant and landlord were also emailed.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No. This is a routine guarantee return visit. A human is needed only if the provider refuses or the invoice dispute is not settled.

args.body: Dear Lantern Services, the washing machine at Flat 20, 120 Alder Lane (NBL-042) has the same fault again: the tenant says it worked for a couple of washes after your repair, but the water has not heated on the 60°C cycle for about 5 days. Please treat this as a return visit under your workmanship guarantee at no extra charge. Please contact the tenant using the details from the original job email (07700 900566, enter the code when calling), and reply to confirm the date and time. Please also send photos and a note of what was done. We are holding your invoice of £75.11 until this is resolved. Thank you.
